{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {df['customer_age'].eq(-1).sum()}")

# Check revenue dtype and example values
print(f"Revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"First 5 revenue values: {df['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {df['status'].eq('refunded').sum()}")

# Check for QA orders with 999999.99 revenue
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue=999999.99): {df['revenue'].eq('999999.99').sum()}")

# Inspect the data
print("\nData types:")
print(df.dtypes)

print("\nSummary of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].describe())"}
